assumptions.choice: 20-bar rolling maximum of the High series defines the 'recent high' for the initial pullback entry signal
assumptions.reason: Spec names a 'recent high' without specifying a lookback window; 20 bars is a conventional short-term lookback for a daily trend-following system

assumptions.choice: After each filled buy, ref_high resets to the high of the fill bar; while in a position, ref_high tracks the running maximum High seen since the last entry
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'from the next high' without defining how that high is identified; the running maximum since the last entry captures any post-entry bounce that forms the next local high

assumptions.choice: Take-profit is measured from the first entry's executed price using the ATR captured at first-entry fill time; triggered when the bar's High reaches or exceeds that fixed level
assumptions.reason: Spec says '2.5 ATR from the entry point' (singular); with multiple scale-in entries, 'the entry point' is interpreted as the initial entry; the bar High is used to detect intraday reach of the TP level

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss is checked against the bar's Low (intraday detection); if any individual entry's stop is breached, the entire accumulated position is closed via self.close()
assumptions.reason: Spec sets per-entry stops but says 'the position is forcibly closed' on trigger; backtrader does not support closing individual lots from an accumulated position, so all lots are closed; Low rather than Close is used for stop detection on daily OHLCV bars

assumptions.choice: Within a bar, stop-loss is evaluated first, then EMA-cross exit, then take-profit; scale-in is only considered if no exit condition fires
assumptions.reason: Spec does not define priority when multiple conditions fire on the same bar; protective stop takes precedence as the primary risk-management mechanism

assumptions.choice: size = floor(0.01 * broker.getvalue() / close); at $10,000 starting capital with AAPL above $100 this yields 0–1 shares per entry
assumptions.reason: Spec defines 1% of total capital per entry in position-value terms; implemented exactly as stated; the small capital base relative to AAPL price produces minimal share counts but fidelity to the spec is preserved

assumptions.choice: Strategy operates on the provided daily feed without modification
assumptions.reason: Spec targets D1; the harness supplies 1-day bars so no adaptation is needed

assumptions.choice: The blocked flag and all entry tracking reset only when the entire position is fully closed (notify_trade isclosed)
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'do not open new positions until all current positions are fully closed'; resetting on full position close matches this condition exactly
